problem_statement:
Bar chart "categoryPercentage: 1" and "barPercentage: 1" are not really 100% width
## Expected Behavior
Bars should have 100% width without any empty space or borders between them.
Like here: https://chartio.com/images/tutorials/charts/histograms/histogram-example-1.png

## Current Behavior
Bars have empty space or borders between them, and not same between each bar

## Steps to Reproduce
https://codepen.io/gagrison/pen/NWjrEMq

## Context
I'm trying to make histogram chart with connected bars like here:
https://chartio.com/images/tutorials/charts/histograms/histogram-example-1.png

## Environment

* Chart.js version: 3.4.0
* Browser name and version: Chrome 91.0.4472.114
* Link to your project: https://codepen.io/gagrison/pen/NWjrEMq
hints_text:
Duplicate of #9158
So the stepped line chart is the solution.
What if I want to show border for bar chart like this?
https://ibb.co/FwkY3J9
Stepped line was a solution to that use case. With borders, you also get artifacts between the border and the bar.
